entities.text: Patram Bishnoi vs State Of Mah., Thr. Pso Wadi P S Dist
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1 (i) The learned APP on instructions of Shri Kiran R. Gedam, Food Safety Officer,
Nagpur submits that in terms of provisions of Section 38(1)(c) proviso of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, necessary bond with an undertaking would be taken from the applicants herein.

He further states that, if such bond with the undertaking is executed voluntarily by the applicants, the 70APL 661.19.odt respondents shall de-seal the Godown of the applicants within seven days from the date of execution of bond and undertaking.

(ii) The learned Advocate for the applicants, on instructions, submits that the applicants are ready to execute the bond in terms of Section 38(1)(c) proviso of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and are also ready to file an undertaking to the effect that in future they would not keep contraband articles like Gutkha etc. in their Godown and they will not use their Godown for storing those articles in future.
We further direct that though investigation to continue, charge-sheet shall not be filed without seeking leave of this Court.
JUDGE JUDGE Sumit Ramkisan S/O Patram Bishnoi vs State Of Mah., Thr. Pso Wadi P S Dist ... on 8 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120813900/
